look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: How XORA analyses a coin
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 6 XORA Intelligence, lesson T25; the tutor walks in beside a turning candle ring.

scenes.name: The routine
scenes.desc: Seven steps light up in order: candles, volatility and swings, trend, zones, movement, setups, a plan for one candle.

scenes.name: Candles in
scenes.desc: A fictional BTC/USDT 1-minute chart draws in; side panel lists the data: 1-minute history, bigger timeframes, order book.

scenes.name: Closed candles only
scenes.desc: The last candle flickers while forming and is ignored; when it closes it is locked in and a fresh plan is made.

scenes.name: Volatility
scenes.desc: Volatility: the five latest candle ranges 60, 50, 40, 50, 100 USDT average 60 USDT (a simple ATR).

scenes.name: Swings and trend
scenes.desc: Swing highs and lows are marked; highs 60,100 to 60,250 and lows 59,900 to 60,040 make an UP trend; trend per timeframe panel.

scenes.name: Support and resistance zones
scenes.desc: Zones are drawn around swing points: support 60,000 to 60,060, resistance 60,480 to 60,530.

scenes.name: Movement
scenes.desc: Three meters: momentum rising, buyer pressure growing, volume above its recent average.

scenes.name: Candidate setups
scenes.desc: Four mini charts: reaction at support, rejection at resistance, breakout, retest.

scenes.name: A plan for one candle
scenes.desc: Setup candle at support; trigger 60,120, stop 59,940, risk 180 USDT per BTC (0.30%), next resistance 60,480 (2 R).

scenes.name: At the trigger
scenes.desc: The next candle trades above 60,120; every check runs again and passes; otherwise the plan expires at the close.

scenes.name: A common mistake
scenes.desc: Mistake: reading the plan as a prediction; correction: it is an if, most plans expire, triggered trades can lose.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and answer: the next candle only reaches 60,100; answer: no trigger, no trade, a fresh plan at the close.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Risk cards: checks read the past, gaps and slippage, fees, demo first.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three points: closed candles and a fresh plan every minute; the analysis steps; a plan is an if for one candle.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T26, understanding AI decisions; risk line.
